projects.title: Travel Frog: A Journey to China — Local Reverse-Engineered Edition
projects.description: Play the unofficial Normal or Gallery edition on Windows, Android, or in your browser.
projects.details: Start fresh or import your progress in the Normal edition. Gallery edition: Unlocks all furniture, items, stories, titles, friendship books, collections, and encyclopedia entries. All static photos and materials for making animated photos are included. Clover and common consumables are unlimited. All limited-time events, including Mid-Autumn Festival, Lunar New Year, and the anniversary, are always available. The Gallery edition uses a separate save.
highlights: Gallery: all furniture, items, stories, titles, friendship books, collections, and encyclopedia entries unlocked
All static photos and materials for animated photos included
All limited-time events available year-round, including Mid-Autumn Festival, Lunar New Year, and the anniversary
Separate saves for the Normal and Gallery editions
projects.imageAlt: Anniversary postcard: the frog and friends gathered around a cake

projects.title: Jizhi Enhanced
projects.description: An unofficial enhancement of Jizhi, a Chinese-poetry new-tab extension with traditional-color animations, offline poems, and customizable fonts. Preview packages are available on GitHub.
projects.details: Based on the original Jizhi extension by Unicar and its contributors. Features include offline poems, animated wave and Blobs backgrounds, poem search and pinning, and bundled fonts including Nüshu Fengqi.
highlights: Offline Chinese poetry with search and pinning
projects.notice: Download the installation packages from GitHub Releases and follow the user guide to get started.
projects.imageAlt: Jizhi Enhanced: Chinese poetry over traditional-color waves

projects.title: FocusBloom
projects.description: A Windows focus and study planner with customizable app restrictions.
projects.details: Focus timers, task and planning lists, a class calendar, and reflection. Core features work offline.
projects.imageAlt: Full-screen focus timer against a lake at dusk
